Package sc.fiji.snt.viewer

Class PathPlayer

java.lang.Object
sc.fiji.snt.viewer.PathPlayer
public class PathPlayer extends Object
Plays a walkthrough along paths in a AbstractBigViewer: the view is centered on a point that travels along each path at constant speed. The camera only translates (rotation is preserved, and the zoom is left untouched unless a field of view is requested), so the user may rotate the view during playback.

The distance covered per tick is fixed (speed * tick period), i.e., it does not depend on how fast the viewer renders: every playback samples the same positions, and the total elapsed time reflects how well the viewer keeps up. This makes playback suitable for reproducible performance tests. Clicking on the display aborts playback.

Author:
Tiago Ferreira
